texts.content:
Within the pulsing textures of the underbrush, a massive creature lurks,
arachnid in form,with dull eyes that distill death. It camouflages
itself among the tangled vegetation, partially
buried in moss, extending long limbs covered in sensory
filaments that grant it extreme perception and predatory agility.

From its low, sprawling posture on the damp forest floor,
it detects even the faintest vibrationv within several meters.Then the
forest responds: rows of sharpened teeth erupt like vegetal arms,
embracing you with brutal force, as if the jungle itself
had chosen to close around you.
